name: School Road
source:
School Road follows the path Martin takes to school, on the same morning, over and over.

Can he figure out how to make there on time or at least how to not get bounced back?

[From [url=https://marionette.itch.io/school-road]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
学校路沿着马丁在同一天早上上学的路，一遍又一遍。

他能弄清楚如何准时到达那里，或者至少如何不被退回吗？

[来自[url=https://marionette.itch.io/school-road]itch.io[/url]]
